title: County and San Diego Foundation Launch Safety Net Services Funding Partnership
description:
San Diego County and San Diego Foundation officials will announce the formal launch of a new public philanthropic partnership intended to shield local safety net services from funding cuts during a time of budget challenges on the Federal, State and local level.

To see auto-generated English captions during this livestream, click on the "cc" icon in the YouTube player.
